name: Ghost Relay / Encrypted Mesh / anti-trace comm array

description.value:
The team's private, hardened net - the backbone the Full Sensorium shares marks over. When the crew needs to talk without corp ears, this is the array.

  • Item Tier: T2
  • Availability: 2
  • Cost: ¥9,000
  • Profile: Crew-wide encrypted comms; bane on enemy attempts to trace or tap the crew's channel. Pairs with the Hacker's Alert-scrub.
  • Mod slots: 4
  • Tags: Wired

Item Tier sets price, Availability, and mod-slot count only — never raw power.
